en.headline: Oxfam considers keeping 20km Trailwalker route after strong debut
en.dek: Organisers reported an 81.6 per cent completion rate on the 100km course and said the limited-edition 20km route drew near-full finishes.
body: Oxfam Hong Kong said it is open to retaining the 20km route introduced this year for Oxfam Trailwalker after the limited-edition course recorded a 99.7 per cent completion rate, while ruling out significant changes to the traditional 100km trail.

According to the organisers, 2,735 participants, or 81.6 per cent of those who started, finished the 100km route from Pak Tam Chung in Sai Kung to Harrow International School in Tuen Mun. The figure was in line with the event’s long-term average completion rate of 70 to 90 per cent. The first team completed the course in 12 hours 50 minutes on 20 November, and the last team finished at 12.15pm on Sunday after 47 hours 45 minutes.

The 20km “Oxfam 50th Anniversary Limited-Edition” route was completed by 1,179 participants. Organisers said the shorter distance allowed more people to take part while the core 100km challenge remained unchanged.
Oxfam Trailwalker is the city’s largest annual hiking fundraising event. This year’s edition marked the organisation’s 50th anniversary.

zh.headline: 樂施毅行者考慮保留20公里路線 100公里完成率81.6%
zh.dek: 主辦方指100公里路線完成率符合長期平均，限定版20公里路線完成率達99.7%。
body: 樂施會表示，今年首次推出的20公里限定路線完成率高達99.7%，主辦方正考慮未來是否繼續保留該路線，但不會對傳統100公里路線作出重大改動。
根據樂施會公布，共有2735名參加者完成由西貢北潭涌出發、終點設於屯門哈羅香港國際學校的100公里全程，完成率為81.6%，與活動長期70%至90%的平均完成率相符。首支隊伍於11月20日以12小時50分率先完成，最後一支隊伍則於周日中午12時15分以47小時45分抵達終點。
「樂施會50周年限定版」20公里路線共有1179人完成。主辦方指較短路線讓更多人參與，而核心的100公里挑戰維持不變。
樂施毅行者是本港一年一度最大型的遠足籌款活動，今屆適逢樂施會成立50周年。
